answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 68 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the voyage challenge, the vertex audit can replay the nectar history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 4734 identities would post 2547 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
